en.summary: The commit fixes bank-completion ordering so a multi-bank writeback flush is not reported done before non-leading banks finish draining their own pending writeback traffic.
why_it_counts: It changes the completion condition in the bank flush RTL.
The patch explicitly orders bank completion relative to remaining memory requests.
The bug can cause a flush to be acknowledged before all dirty writebacks have left the cache.
evidence: VX_bank_flush.sv adds BANK_ID, a WAIT2 state, and a bank_empty input.
Banks other than bank0 now wait for bank_empty after their final flush beat before asserting flush_end.
VX_cache_bank.sv derives no_pending_req from empty pipeline stages and an empty mreq_queue, then feeds it into the flush unit.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: In a banked writeback cache, finishing the per-bank line walk is not always enough to declare the bank drained. A bank may still have locally generated writeback or memory requests queued behind that walk. If a global flush controller allows such a bank to report done immediately, the system can send the final lower-level flush or completion acknowledgement before all dirty data has actually exited the upper cache.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A non-final bank reaches the last flush iteration while its local pipeline or outbound memory-request queue still contains pending writeback traffic.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Let the bank report flush completion immediately after its final scan beat, without waiting for local pending requests to drain.
portability_notes: This is most relevant in banked caches where one designated path emits the final lower-level flush or global completion event.
Map bank_empty to any local notion of no pending pipeline work and no queued outbound writebacks.
Do not change the scan itself; only remove the extra wait between end-of-scan and done reporting.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the bank-local flush FSM state reached after the final line or way has been processed.
Identify the predicate that waits for local request queues and pipeline stages to become empty before asserting bank done.
Remove that predicate for non-leading banks so done is asserted immediately after the last scan handshake.
Preserve the special handling of the bank or path that emits the final lower-level flush, if such a path exists.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: bank-local flush completion after final scan beat
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix adds a bank_empty-driven WAIT2 state for nonzero banks and computes bank_empty from empty pipeline stages plus an empty memory-request queue before allowing flush_end.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Remove WAIT2 and bank_empty gating from VX_bank_flush.sv so nonzero banks transition directly from the final FLUSH beat to DONE, and stop feeding no_pending_req from VX_cache_bank.sv.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: The top-level flush sequence can advance too early, so a lower-level flush or completion acknowledgement is sent before dirty writebacks from other banks have fully drained.
evidence_for_injection: BANK_ID was added so bank0 and nonzero banks can follow different completion rules.
The new no_pending_req signal in VX_cache_bank.sv combines both pipeline idleness and queue emptiness.
The comment in WAIT2 explains that the lower-cache flush goes through bank0 and therefore must be sent last.
notes: This commit refines the earlier flush protocol work by adding a post-scan drain guarantee.
If the target DUT has no designated bank0-like path, inject the same bug as premature per-bank done before local writeback drain.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 bank 完成顺序问题，避免多 bank writeback flush 在非主导 bank 自身未决 writeback 流量尚未排空时就被报告完成。
why_it_counts: 它修改了 bank flush RTL 中的完成条件。
补丁明确规定了 bank 完成信号与剩余内存请求排空之间的先后关系。
这个错误会导致 flush 在所有脏写回真正离开缓存之前就被确认完成。
evidence: VX_bank_flush.sv 新增了 BANK_ID、WAIT2 状态和 bank_empty 输入。
除 bank0 外的其他 bank 现在在最后一个 flush beat 之后必须等待 bank_empty，才会拉起 flush_end。
VX_cache_bank.sv 从空流水线阶段和空 mreq_queue 推导 no_pending_req，并把它送入 flush 单元。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 在 banked writeback cache 中，完成每个 bank 的 line walk 并不总是意味着该 bank 已经彻底排空。这个 bank 可能仍有本地生成的 writeback 或其他内存请求排在后面。如果全局 flush 控制器允许这样的 bank 立即报告 done，那么系统就可能在上层缓存里的所有脏数据尚未真正流出之前，就把最终的下层 flush 或完成确认发出去。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 扫描结束后的 bank 排空完成顺序
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 某个非最终 bank 已经走到最后一次 flush 迭代，但它的本地流水线或出站内存请求队列里仍然有待处理的 writeback 流量。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 让该 bank 在最后一个扫描 beat 结束后立即报告 flush 完成，而不等待本地未决请求排空。
portability_notes: 该故障尤其适用于存在多个 bank，且由某个指定路径发出最终下层 flush 或全局完成事件的缓存。
把 bank_empty 映射为本地无未决流水线工作且无待发 writeback 的条件。
不要修改扫描过程本身，只去掉扫描结束到 done 上报之间的额外等待。
concrete_injection_steps: 定位 bank 本地 flush FSM 在处理完最后一个 line 或 way 后进入的状态。
找出那个在拉起 bank done 之前等待本地请求队列和流水线变空的谓词。
对非主导 bank 去掉这个谓词，使其在最后一次扫描握手后立刻上报 done。
如果设计中存在负责发出最终下层 flush 的专门 bank 或路径，保留它的特殊处理。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: bank 本地 flush 在最后一次扫描后的完成判定
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复为非零 bank 增加了受 bank_empty 驱动的 WAIT2 状态，并通过空流水线阶段加空 memory-request 队列来计算 bank_empty，然后才允许拉起 flush_end。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 删除 VX_bank_flush.sv 中的 WAIT2 和 bank_empty 门控，使非零 bank 在最后一个 FLUSH beat 后直接进入 DONE，同时不再从 VX_cache_bank.sv 提供 no_pending_req。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 顶层 flush 流程会过早推进，导致其他 bank 的脏写回尚未完全排空时，下层 flush 或完成确认就已经发出。
evidence_for_injection: 新增 BANK_ID 是为了让 bank0 和其他 bank 使用不同的完成规则。
VX_cache_bank.sv 中新增的 no_pending_req 同时约束了流水线空闲和队列为空。
WAIT2 中的注释明确说明下层 cache 的 flush 通过 bank0 发送，因此必须最后发出。
notes: 这个提交是在前一个 flush 协议修复之上进一步补充扫描后排空保证。
如果目标 DUT 没有 bank0 这类指定路径，也可以按同样语义注入为 bank 在本地 writeback 排空前过早上报 done。
